name: project-context-curator
description: Maintains durable scoped context with optional cross-project hybrid retrieval.

thread.condition_shell: test "${PROJECT_CONTEXT_CURATOR_DISABLED:-0}" != "1" && root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && common="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || true)" && case "$common" in */.git) root="${common%/.git}" ;; esac && test ! -e "$root/.no-project-context"
thread.text: Capture only durable project knowledge in docs/context. Before any add-* write, search existing context and admit a candidate only if it is expected to outlive the current task or branch, benefit unrelated future work, and is not ordinary implementation detail readily recoverable from code, tests, or docs. Update or consolidate an existing record instead of creating overlap. Do not record behavior introduced by active implementation until the work is complete and verified on a long-lived branch. An explicitly user-confirmed durable invariant or architectural decision may be captured earlier; phrase it as a decision or invariant, not as present behavior. Store admitted knowledge in the same turn. Facts default to project applicability; use workspace, user, machine, or universal applicability only when verified.

interface.longDescription: Project Context Curator captures durable scoped knowledge in canonical context files and can retrieve relevant facts across configured projects through an optional local hybrid index.
interface.defaultPrompt: Maintain project context while working in this repository.
